summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return detailing share repurchases for cancellation. Between May 27 and June 23, 2026, the company repurchased approximately 10.4 million Class A ordinary shares at prices ranging from USD 6.55 to 7.25 per share, representing less than 0.1% of outstanding per day. The repurchases are ongoing open-market buybacks under a previously announced program. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Shares are held for cancellation, reducing share count over time. This is a capital return to shareholders via buybacks. Watch for subsequent announcements on cancellation completion and potential impact on earnings per share.
